name: Arihants Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Arihant’s Securities Ltd is in the business of investments and loan financing[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ASL is a registered Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Corporation, primarily engaged in loan financing, share trading, and other financial services. Its income stems from investments in shares and securities, loan interest, and miscellaneous financial activities. Currently, the company focuses mainly on share trading.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.29 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 57.4 to 22.6 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.31% over last 3 years.
